CHAPTER VI DISCUSSION OF PROBLEMS AND OBJECTIONS RAISED
The problems raised by the responding agencies fall for the most part into three categories: (1) those that suggested revision and/or refinement of the Draft Statement; (2) those that requested additional information to be included in the Final Statement; and (3) those that objected to the project because of environmental problems which might result from its approval. In general, revisions of the original statement have been made in response to suggestions whenever it appears that these changes would result in a clearer presentation of the environmental issues involved. The various requests for additional pieces of information have been honored in a separate section of this chapter unless these requests appeared irrelevant for the specifics of this case.
In response to the distribution of this statement, comments have been received from 9 agencies. HUD has prepared, according to Council on Environmental Quality guidelines, responses to these comments. These replies have been included in a summary format and have been included immediately following an agency's comments. Where the same comments have been raised by several agencies only one response has been prepared.
